name: FromNarrative
title: Narrative Conformance Statements
description: Conformance statements found throughout the narrative of the IG consolidated into this computable resource for traceability purposes

statement.requirement: Use of Conformance Verbs^This implementation guide uses specific terminology such as **SHALL**, **SHOULD**, **MAY** to flag statements that have relevance for the evaluation of conformance with the guide.

This guide inherits all conformance expectations identified in the Health Record Exchange (Hrex) Conformance Expectations section. All systems claiming conformance to this guide **SHALL** conform to the requirements listed in that section.

Server Actors claiming conformance to the REST API in this guide **SHALL** meet the capability statement expectation requirements identified in the [Plan Net CapabilityStatement](CapabilityStatement-plan-net.html) and **SHALL** have a CapabilityStatement that has a CapabilityStatement.instantiates containing the canonical URL http://hl7.org/fhir/us/davinci-pdex-plan-net/CapabilityStatement/plan-net or a URL to the appropriate version of the CapabilityStatement.

Server Actors claiming conformance to this guide SHOULD meet the capability statement expectation requirements identified in the [Plan-Net Bulk Publish CapabilityStatement](CapabilityStatement-plan-net-bulk-publish.html). Server Actors claiming conformance to this guide MAY have a CapabilityStatement that has a CapabilityStatement.instantiates with a URL of http://hl7.org/fhir/us/davinci-pdex-plan-net/CapabilityStatement/plan-net-bulk-publish.

statement.label: Server Actor Requirements
statement.requirement:
Server Actor Requirements

* Health Plan API actors **SHALL** be capable of populating all Must Support data elements as part of the query results.
* In situations where information on a particular Must Support data element is not present and the minimum cardinality is 0 , the Health Plan API actors **SHALL NOT** include the data elements in the resource instance returned as part of the query results.
* In situations where information on a particular data element is not present and the minimum cardinality is >0 **SHALL** send the reason for the missing information using values (such as nullFlavors) from the value set where they exist or use the dataAbsentReason extension.

statement.label: Application Actor Requirements
statement.requirement:
Application Actor Requirements

* Application actors **SHALL** be capable of processing resource instances containing the Must Support data elements without generating an error or causing the application to fail.
* Application actors **SHOULD** be capable of displaying the data elements for human use or storing the information for other purposes.
* When querying Health Plan API actors, Application actors **SHALL** interpret missing Must Support data elements within resource instances as data not present in the Health Plan API actors system.
* Consumer App actors **SHALL** be able to process resource instances containing Must Support data elements asserting missing information.
A conformant Plan-Net service **SHALL NOT** require a directory mobile application to send consumer identifying information in order to query content.
A directory mobile application **SHALL NOT** send consumer identifiable information when querying a Plan-Net service.

Server Actors **SHALL** use the [Plan-Net profiles and search parameters](artifacts.html) defined in this IG as well as the [core FHIR R4 search parameters](implementation.html#search-parameters) used by this IG consistently in order to achieve true interoperability of directory information among payers. The intent of this section is to provide examples of the canonical use of the profiles provided in this IG that will guide implementers towards the consistent use of these profiles that will enable 3rd party applications to search the data. The Plan-Net design is based around the following types of searches.

When sourcing data from other sources such as a generic FHIR server, setting active to false in the source system will make the data invalid from a Plan-Net perspective, so it **SHALL** be removed from the target Plan-Net directory.
Server Actors **SHALL** provide appropriate set of [Plan-Net HealthcareService](StructureDefinition-plannet-HealthcareService.html) instances

statement.label: Plan Net Search Parameter Requirements
statement.requirement:
Plan-Net servers and clients **SHALL** support the following search parameters:

* All the search parameters defined on the [Artifacts](artifacts.html) page of this IG.
* All the seach parameters defined in the [US Core implementation guide](http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/STU7) for the US core resources inherited in this IG.
* The following [Core FHIR R4](http://hl7.org/fhir/r4) search parameters:

[Endpoint](https://hl7.org/fhir/R4/endpoint.html#search)

* organization

[HealthcareService](https://hl7.org/fhir/R4/healthcareservice.html#search)

* coverage-area
* identifier
* endpoint
* location
* name
* organization
* service-category
* service-type
* specialty

[InsurancePlan](https://hl7.org/fhir/R4/insuranceplan.html#search)

* administered-by
* identifier
* name
* owned-by
* type

[Location](https://hl7.org/fhir/R4/location.html#search)

* address
* address-city
* address-country
* address-postalcode
* address-state
* address-use
* endpoint
* organization
* partof
* type

[Organization](https://hl7.org/fhir/R4/organization.html#search)

* address
* endpoint
* name
* partof
* type

[OrganizationAffiliation](https://hl7.org/fhir/R4/organizationaffiliation.html#search)

* endpoint
* location
* network
* participating-organization
* primary-organization
* role
* service
* specialty

[Practitioner](https://hl7.org/fhir/R4/practitioner.html#search)

* family
* given
* name

[PractitionerRole](https://hl7.org/fhir/R4/practitionerrole.html#search)

* endpoint
* location
* organization
* practitioner
* role
* service
* specialty

Plan-Net servers and clients **SHOULD** support all core FHIR search parameters for the resources used in this IG.

Note that versions of Plan Net prior to 2.0.0 contained custom search parameters that were duplicates of core FHIR search parameters. Those have been removed in 2.0.0 and later releases. See the [Change Log](ChangeHistory.html#changes-and-updates-for-version-200-ballot) for details.

#### Chaining and Reverse Chaining Requirements

Server Actors **SHALL** support chaining for the following resources and search parameters and **SHOULD** support reverse chaining as well.

| | | |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Endpoint | [organization][endpoint-organization] | `name`,`address`,`partof`,`type` |
| HealthcareService | [endpoint][healthcareservice-endpoint] | `organization` |
| HealthcareService | [location][healthcareservice-location] | `address`,`address-postalcode`,`address-city`,`address-state`,`organization`,`type` |
| HealthcareService | [organization][healthcareservice-organization] | `name`,`address`,`partof`,`type` |
| InsurancePlan | [administered-by][insuranceplan-administered-by] | `name`,`partof` |
| InsurancePlan | [owned-by][insuranceplan-owned-by] | `name`,`partof` |
| Location | [endpoint][location-endpoint] | `organization` |
| Location | [organization][location-organization] | `name`,`address`,`partof`,`type` |
| Location | [partof][location-partof] | `type`,`address`,`organization` |
| Organization | [endpoint][organization-endpoint] | `organization` |
| Organization | [partof][organization-partof] | `name`,`address`,`type` |
| OrganizationAffiliation | [endpoint][organizationaffiliation-endpoint] | `organization` |
| OrganizationAffiliation | [location][organizationaffiliation-location] | `address`,`address-postalcode`,`address-city`,`address-state`,`organization`,`type` |
| OrganizationAffiliation | [network][organizationaffiliation-network] | `name`,`partof` |
| OrganizationAffiliation | [participating-organization][organizationaffiliation-participating-organization] | `type`,`address`,`name`,`partof` |
| OrganizationAffiliation | [primary-organization][organizationaffiliation-primary-organization] | `type`,`address`,`name`,`partof` |
| OrganizationAffiliation | [service][organizationaffiliation-service] | `service-category`,`organization`,`location` |
| PractitionerRole | [endpoint][practitionerrole-endpoint] | `organization` |
| PractitionerRole | [location][practitionerrole-location] | `address`,`address-postalcode`,`address-city`,`address-state`,`organization`,`type` |
| PractitionerRole | [network][practitionerrole-network] | `name`,`address`,`partof`,`type` |
| PractitionerRole | [organization][practitionerrole-organization] | `name`,`address`,`partof`,`type` |
| PractitionerRole | [practitioner][practitionerrole-practitioner] | `name` |
| PractitionerRole | [service][practitionerrole-service] | `service-category`,`organization`,`location` |

statement.label: Bulk Data Requirements
statement.requirement:
Plan-Net servers SHOULD support one or both of the following Bulk Data mechanisms

* **[Bulk Export](https://hl7.org/fhir/uv/bulkdata/4.0.0-202609-ballot/en/export.html):** Enables a Data Consumer to request and retrieve directory information from a Plan-Net server using an asynchronous export operation.
* **[Bulk Publish](https://hl7.org/fhir/uv/bulkdata/4.0.0-202609-ballot/en/publish.html):** Enables a Data Provider to publish directory information as downloadable files for retrieval by multiple Data Consumers without requiring each consumer to initiate a separate export.

Implementations supporting either mechanism **SHALL** conform to the applicable requirements of the Bulk Data Access IG.

#### Plan-Net Bulk Data Resources

A Plan-Net Bulk Data dataset **SHOULD** include all applicable resources conforming to the Plan-Net profiles defined in this IG, including the following FHIR resource types:

| | |
| :--- | :--- |
| `InsurancePlan` | Insurance products and their associated provider networks. |
| `Organization` | Payers, provider organizations, facilities, and networks. |
| `OrganizationAffiliation` | Relationships between organizations, including network participation. |
| `Practitioner` | Individual healthcare practitioners. |
| `PractitionerRole` | Practitioner roles, specialties, practice locations, and network participation. |
| `HealthcareService` | Healthcare services provided by organizations and practitioners. |
| `Location` | Physical and virtual service locations, including geographic coverage areas. |
| `Endpoint` | Electronic service endpoints associated with directory entities. |

The dataset **SHOULD** include sufficient related resources to allow Data Consumers to resolve references and reconstruct the relationships between insurance plans, networks, providers, healthcare services, locations, and endpoints.

Resources included in a Bulk Data dataset **SHALL** conform to the applicable Plan-Net profiles and requirements defined in this IG.

#### Bulk Export

Plan-Net servers supporting Bulk Export **SHOULD** support the [System Level Export](https://hl7.org/fhir/uv/bulkdata/4.0.0-202609-ballot/en/export.html) operation:

`POST [base]/$export`

The system-level export enables Data Consumers to retrieve Plan-Net directory information, including resources that are not associated with individual patients.

For Bulk Export:

* The server **SHALL** support exporting all eight Plan-Net resource types listed above.
* The server **SHOULD** support the `_type` parameter to allow Data Consumers to request specific resource types.
* The server **SHOULD** support the `_since` parameter to allow Data Consumers to retrieve resources updated since a specified point in time, consistent with the Bulk Data Access IG.
* The server **SHOULD** include resources of the requested types that are necessary to represent the directory information within the scope of the export.
* The server **SHALL** implement the applicable Bulk Data Export kick-off, status, and file retrieval interactions as defined in the Bulk Data Access IG.

Exported resources are delivered in newline-delimited JSON (NDJSON) files, with the file locations identified in the Bulk Data Export completion manifest.

#### Bulk Publish

Plan-Net servers supporting Bulk Publish **SHOULD** implement the [Bulk Publish](https://hl7.org/fhir/uv/bulkdata/4.0.0-202609-ballot/en/publish.html) mechanism defined in the Bulk Data Access IG.

Bulk Publish allows a Data Provider to make Plan-Net directory data available through a published manifest and associated downloadable resource files. Unlike Bulk Export, the Data Provider determines the contents of the published dataset, and multiple Data Consumers may retrieve the same published files.

For Bulk Publish:

* The Data Provider **SHALL** support publishing all eight Plan-Net resource types listed above, as applicable to the directory.
* The Data Provider **SHALL** make a Bulk Publish manifest available through an HTTP GET endpoint terminating in `$bulk-publish`, as defined in the Bulk Data Access IG.
* The manifest **SHALL** identify the downloadable files containing the published FHIR resources.
* The published files **SHALL** conform to the applicable file format, access, and retrieval requirements of the Bulk Data Access IG.
* The Data Provider **SHOULD** update the published dataset regularly to reflect changes to directory information.

Bulk Publish also supports incremental updates, allowing Data Providers to publish changes to directory information without requiring Data Consumers to download the entire dataset each time. Implementations **MAY** use this capability to distribute additions, modifications, and deletions to directory resources.

A draft CapabilityStatement for Bulk Publish is available on the [Artifacts](artifacts.html) page of this specification. The CapabilityStatement uses rest.operation to declare $bulk-publish, without requiring conventional FHIR resource-level REST interactions. This is consistent with the ballot's allowance for a simple HTTP server to host Bulk Publish. This will likely be updated when Bulk Data 4.0.0 is updated with it's own Bulk Publish CapabilityStatement, which the authors agreed to add during ballot reconciliation.

#### Bulk Data Security and Authorization

Plan-Net directory information is generally intended to be publicly accessible. Bulk Data implementations **SHOULD** provide unauthenticated access to public directory data, consistent with the privacy and security requirements of this IG.

When authentication or authorization is required, implementations **SHALL** follow the applicable security requirements of the Bulk Data Access IG, including its guidance for [SMART Backend Services Authorization](https://hl7.org/fhir/uv/bulkdata/4.0.0-202609-ballot/en/authorization.html).
Users of this implementation guide **SHALL** conform to the [Da Vinci HRex](http://hl7.org/fhir/us/davinci-hrex/1.2.0/security.html) guidelines on privacy, safety, and security.
